scope_change: Remove the predicate-oracle controller and all five-step coached conditions from the study. Evaluate only direct, episode-static task language at each checkpoint's native action horizon.
rationale: A privileged simulator-state coach measures whether an ideal controller can expose low-level skills; it does not measure whether the released model grounds the user's task language directly.
The VLA and WAM were not trained under the same subtask-coaching interface, so oracle gains or failures would be difficult to interpret as a model-class difference.
Task-level declarative and contrastive prompts preserve the user's actual intervention while testing syntactic robustness and semantic scope.

known_before_this_amendment: All 40 definitive Cosmos canonical and short-paraphrase native-horizon outcomes.
All 10 Cosmos canonical five-step static outcomes: 2 successes and 8 failures.
One excluded seed-5190 predicate-oracle pilot failure.
Eight completed episodes from the interrupted predicate-oracle batch: 0 successes; five left and three right.
not_known_before_this_amendment: Any declarative-goal outcome for either checkpoint.

outcome_timing_disclosure.analysis_tier: The original 80-episode canonical/short grid remains the preregistered confirmatory tier. The 80-episode declarative/contrastive grid is a post-interim, prospectively frozen stress-test tier and must be labeled as such rather than retroactively called preregistered.

retired_conditions.preservation: Completed and partial outputs remain in explicitly labeled supporting or setup-exclusion directories for provenance and are never pooled with the direct-language grid.

direct_language_conditions.controller: static episode-level task instruction; no prompt switching and no simulator-state access

declarative_goal.left: The rubiks cube should end up to the left of the bowl
declarative_goal.right: The rubiks cube should end up to the right of the bowl
declarative_goal.purpose: Test whether an end-state description grounds like an imperative task caption.

contrastive_goal.left: Put the rubiks cube to the left of the bowl, not to the right of the bowl
contrastive_goal.right: Put the rubiks cube to the right of the bowl, not to the left of the bowl
contrastive_goal.purpose: Test semantic scope when both direction tokens are present and the incorrect relation is explicitly negated.

claim_boundary: The revised study estimates direct task-language steerability for two released DROID checkpoints on one matched spatial task family. It does not measure learned high-level reasoning, prove a VLA-versus-WAM class effect, or establish robustness beyond the tested prompts, seeds, and scene.
